params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 reportedly hit around 20 million preorders before launch Analysts estimate that Grand Theft Auto 6 sold roughly 20 million copies through preorders alone before its general release. The figure is an analyst estimate, not an official number from Rockstar or Take-Two, but it fits the record preorder run the game has been on. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 14:39 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 👥 @RockstarGames 🔥 React if you're one of the 20 million · 💬 Did you preorder? #GTA6 #RockstarGames #TakeTwo #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
